$comment: MCP server registration for the mixshift-ai plugin.
Empty for now — the harness owns all warehouse access via mysql2 with
credentials loaded from ~/.mixshift/auth/credentials.json. Skills route
data queries through `mixshift data ...` CLI commands, not MCP tools.
Why no generic MCP server here:
- The third-party `mysql-mcp-server` package we previously registered
needed env vars at spawn time (${MIXSHIFT_MYSQL_HOST} etc.) which
aren't set in the plugin runtime — credentials live in the auth
file the harness reads, not in shell env.
- Even with creds, it would expose generic `list_tables` /
`execute_query` MCP tools that bypass our curated catalog, friendly
error classification, CSV export, and access-denied → Discord
webhook flow. Claude would naturally pick the MCP path over the
skill path because it's one fewer tool call, defeating the value
of the data-explore skill.
Future: register a MixShift-built MCP server that:
- Reads creds from ~/.mixshift/auth/credentials.json
- Exposes catalog-aware tools (list_curated_tables, sample,
export_csv) matching the harness command surface
- Routes access-denied through the same Discord webhook
- Emits telemetry events
Until then, all data access flows: user → SKILL.md → Bash → mixshift
(bin wrapper) → harness/dist/cli.js → mysql2 → warehouse.
